model_status: Proposed transitive routing reference model, not deployed Union or project pool

invariants.rule: For each origin, sum(active reserved principal+reserved fees across every borrower/path) <= funded origin stake. Cycles or diamonds cannot add stake.
For each directed authorized edge, sum(active reservations using edge) <= edge limit. Intermediate cannot invent downstream origin authorization.
Read capacities, reserve origin+all edges, allocate loan and transfer principal in one atomic state transition. Failure changes no balances, locks, debts or graph.

Root explicitly authorizes scope allowing downstream routing, intermediate identities/depth or delegation scope, maturity and maximum loss. Direct trust to coordinator alone does not imply consent to arbitrary stranger collateral use.
Origin withdrawal <= stake minus all active reserved liabilities. Active reservations cannot be bypassed by edge revocation, stake relocation, route deletion or partial repayment.
Unlock only actually extinguished principal/secured liability; token rounding must not close unpaid principal. Received interest and full loan close do not fabricate origin stake.
Burn/use origin stake to extinguish defaulted secured principal; never unlock it into reusable backing before loss recognized. History never restores lost dollars.
Borrowed liquidity cannot be counted again as externally funded loss-bearing stake unless separately capitalized risk and provenance are explicitly accounted.
Admission uses authorized graph/stake/path-capacity terms only; no oracle, credit-officer score grant or hidden seed credit permitted.
